get.summary:
GetPayment retrieves detailed information about a specific payment by its ID.
Returns a complete Payment object containing all payment details.
get.description:
Possible errors:
- NOT_FOUND if the payment doesn't exist
- PERMISSION_DENIED if the caller lacks access rights

parameters.name: id
parameters.description:
Unique identifier of the payment to retrieve.
This ID is required and must be a valid payment ID in the system.

post.summary:
ListPayments retrieves a paginated list of payments based on specified criteria.
Supports filtering by order IDs and includes pagination for handling large result sets.
post.description:
Possible errors:
- INVALID_ARGUMENT if pagination parameters are invalid
- PERMISSION_DENIED if the caller lacks access rights

parameters.name: body
parameters.description:
ListPaymentsRequest encapsulates the parameters for listing payments.
Supports pagination and filtering to customize the result set.

PaymentModule.description:
Module identifies the business area associated with the payment.
This affects accounting categorization and reporting.

 - MODULE_UNSPECIFIED: Unknown or invalid module
Should not be used when creating new payments
 - GROOMING: Payment for pet grooming services
Includes all grooming-related charges
 - RETAIL: Payment for retail product purchases
Includes all product sales
 - MEMBERSHIP: Payment for membership fees or subscriptions
Includes recurring and one-time membership charges

currencyCode.description: The three-letter currency code defined in ISO 4217.

units.description:
The whole units of the amount.
For example if `currencyCode` is `"USD"`, then 1 unit is one US dollar.

nanos.description:
Number of nano (10^-9) units of the amount.
The value must be between -999,999,999 and +999,999,999 inclusive.
If `units` is positive, `nanos` must be positive or zero.
If `units` is zero, `nanos` can be positive, zero, or negative.
If `units` is negative, `nanos` must be negative or zero.
For example $-1.75 is represented as `units`=-1 and `nanos`=-750,000,000.

typeMoney.description: Represents an amount of money with its currency type.

pagination.description:
Pagination parameters to control the size and position of the result set.
Required to manage large result sets efficiently.

companyId.description:
Company identifier for access control and scoping.
Required to ensure payments are only accessed within the proper context.

filter.description: Filter criteria to apply to the payment list query.

v1ListPaymentsRequest.description:
ListPaymentsRequest encapsulates the parameters for listing payments.
Supports pagination and filtering to customize the result set.

orderIds.description:
Optional list of order IDs to filter payments by.
If provided, only payments associated with these orders will be returned.

v1ListPaymentsRequestFilter.description:
Filter defines the criteria for filtering the payment list.
Contains optional parameters to narrow down the result set.

nextPageToken.description:
Token for retrieving the next page of results.
Empty if there are no more results available.

payments.description:
List of payments matching the request criteria.
May be empty if no payments match the specified filters.

v1ListPaymentsResponse.description: ListPaymentsResponse contains the paginated list of payments and pagination metadata.

pageSize.title:
integer, Number of items to return per page.
Minimum: 1, Maximum: 500

pageToken.description:
string, Token for retrieving the next page.
Obtained from the previous page's response.
Leave empty for the first page.

v1Pagination.description:
The pagination object provides a standardized way to handle paginated results
across all API endpoints. It supports both cursor-based and offset-based
pagination, with configurable page sizes and sorting options. This ensures
consistent and efficient data retrieval for large result sets.

id.title:
Unique identifier for the payment
Format: "py_" followed by random characters

businessId.title:
ID of the business location processing the payment
Required. Must be a valid business ID

orderId.title:
ID of the order being paid for
Required. Must be a valid order ID

customerId.title:
ID of the customer making the payment
Required. Must be a valid customer ID

customerName.title:
Display name of the customer
Used for receipts and reporting

status.title:
Current status of the payment
Determines available actions and processing flow

module.title:
Business module associated with the payment
Used for revenue categorization

amount.title:
Amount being processed
Must be greater than zero

processingFee.title:
Fees charged by payment processor
Deducted from the payment amount

refundAmount.title:
Amount that has been refunded
Updated when refunds are processed

createdTime.title:
When this payment was created
System-generated timestamp

lastUpdatedTime.title:
When this payment was last modified
System-generated timestamp

refunds.title:
Detailed refund information
Contains individual refund records with amounts and timestamps

v1Payment.description:
Payment represents a financial transaction that processes funds for an order.
Each payment tracks the amount, processing status, and associated fees. Payments
can be made for various business modules and support multiple payment methods.

v1PaymentStatus.description:
Status represents the current state of the payment in its lifecycle.
This determines what actions can be taken and affects reporting.

 - STATUS_UNSPECIFIED: Unknown or invalid status
Should not be used when creating new payments
 - CREATED: Payment has been initiated but not processed
Initial state for new payments
 - PROCESSING: Payment is being processed by the payment provider
Temporary state during processing
 - PAID: Funds have been successfully transferred
Awaiting final reconciliation
 - COMPLETED: Payment has been fully reconciled
Final state for successful payments
 - FAILED: Payment processing encountered an error
May be retried depending on the error

amount.title:
Amount refunded
Must be greater than zero and not exceed remaining balance

processedTime.title:
When the refund was processed
System-generated timestamp

staffId.title:
ID of the staff member who processed the refund
Optional. May be empty for system-initiated refunds

paymentId.title:
Reference to the original transaction
Links to the payment ID this refund belongs to

v1Refund.description:
Refund represents a partial or full return of payment funds.
Each refund tracks the amount returned, reason, and processing timestamp.
Multiple refunds can be applied to a single payment.
